senses.definition: be different from others; be distinctive

examples.sentence: 叔父觉得这孩子与众不同，常常帮助他。
examples.gloss: to stand out from the crowd

previous.explanation_en: 与众不同 describes someone or something as different from other people or things: 与众 sets others as the comparison group, and 不同 means “not the same.”

parts.contribution_en: with others as the comparison group

requests.reason: Focused decomposition correction after independent audit: 与众 is a preposition+noun phrase here, not a reusable lexical unit. Split it into its characters while retaining 不同 as a word. Use structured parts 与|众|不同, with precise contributions. Preserve the whole-word meaning and all senses. Do not invent standalone dictionary words from convenient halves of an expression. Do not introduce historical claims or rewrite unrelated explanations.
